newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco seeks $209 million tenders for motorway.
newsitem.headline: Morocco seeks $209 million tenders for motorway.

text.p: Morocco next month will seek international tenders to build a $209.3 million toll motorway to link Casablanca and Jorf Lasfar on the Atlantic coast, the public works ministry said on Friday.
"The ministry will launch an international tender for 120 km (75 miles) of motorway to link Casablanca to the industrial area of Jorf Lasfar," a ministry official said.
"The tenders will be sought next month," he added.
Moroccan, Spanish, French, Italian and Cypriot companies are expected to tender, he said, adding that the toll concession is expected to last for about 20 years.

Morocco already has 220 kms (140 miles) of toll motorway from Casablanca to the northern city of Larache, near Tangier. It plans a total of around 1,000 km (625 miles) of motorway by the end of the century.
